opening.argument: The speaker warns viewers against the platform he reviews, but then promotes a separate earning system of his own. He says people using that system make over three thousand dollars a day and tells viewers they can get access to it through the link below the video. The description reinforces the pitch with a step-by-step passive-income system claiming daily rewards and students earning 60% or more APY. The reviewed platform's advertised daily returns provide context, but the concern is the speaker's separate invitation to pursue unusually high earnings. The record does not establish that viewers lost money or that the claimed earnings occurred.
